BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING OF SEPTEMBER 26, 2017
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meeting of September 26, 2017.
A-1 Minutes 9-26-17 CC-SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT NO. 17-01 - CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT NO. 17-01 FOR THE 2017 UPDATE TO THE 2013-2021 HOUSING ELEMENT OF THE LA PUENTE GENERAL PLAN AND ADDENDUM NO. 3 TO THE FINAL ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 17-5368 approving General Plan Amendment No. 17-01 for the 2017 update to the 2013-2021 Housing Element and approve Addendum No. 3 to the Final Environmental Impact Report.
B-1 2013-2021 Housing Element Update Staff Report
B-1 2013-2021 Housing Element Update Attachment A HCD 2016 Letter
B-1 2013-2021 Housing Element Update Attachment B HCD 2017 Letter
B-1 2013-2021 Housing Element Update Attachment C Resolution
B-1 2013-2021 Housing Element Update Attachment D Update
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
UPDATE ON THE STATUS OF THE CITY'S EMERGENCY PREPAREDNESS PLANS
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the update.
C-1 Emergency Plans Update Staff Report
C-1 Emergency Plans Update Attachment A Hazard Mitigation Plan
C-1 Emergency Plans Update Attachment B Emergency Ops Plan
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1438
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 17-5369 approving Warrant Register No. 1438.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1438
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF AN AMENDMENT TO THE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF LA PUENTE AND WILLDAN FINANCIAL SERVICES TO DEVELOP A COST ALLOCATION PLAN AND CONDUCT A USER FEE STUDY IN THE AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $34,735.00
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve Amendment No. 1 with Willdan Financial Services for the Cost Allocation Plan and User Fee Study; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the amendment on behalf of the City.
D-2 Willdan Fee Study Amendment Staff Report
D-2 Willdan Fee Study Amendment Attachment A Amendment
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR THE PARK RESTROOM IMPROVEMENT PROJECT AT LA PUENTE PARK
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the plans and specifications for the Park Restroom Improvement Project; and (2) authorize Staff to solicit for bids.
D-3 Authorization to Bid Park Restroom Project Staff Report
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION TO JOIN THE TAKING BACK OUR COMMUNITY COALITION
It is recommended that the City Council approve Resolution No. 17-5370 approving the City of La Puente's membership in the Taking Back Our Community Coalition.
D-4 Taking Back Our Community Staff Report
D-4 Taking Back our Community Attachment A Resolution
D-5
PRESENTATION OF THE FY 2017-2018 FIRST QUARTER INVESTMENT REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
D-5 FY 17-18 First Quarter Investment Report Staff Report
D-5 FY 17-18 First Quarter Investment Report Attachment A Investment Report
D-5 FY 17-18 First Quarter Investment Report Attachment B CD

ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
